title: Handoff Delivery Attempt
description: One transport attempt inside one delivery. A delivery is a first-class tracked entity, not a side effect of a notification sweep: escalation, reminders, re-delivery, and channel fallback all mint deliveries, never requests (I3). The root of this schema is a single attempt; `$defs/Delivery` is the containing record.

outcome.description: `accepted` means the transport took it — it is not evidence a person received anything. Only a grade above `dispatched` is that (see Delivery.grade_reached).

transport_status.description: Transport-native status, e.g. an HTTP status code or a provider error name. Opaque to the core.

error.description: Human-readable failure detail. MUST NOT contain a secret value or a resolvable capability address (I8, I18).

next_attempt_at.description: Set while the delivery is `retrying`. Backoff MUST be exponential with jitter.

delivery_id.description: Present when the attempt is served outside its delivery record.

request_id.description: Present when the attempt is served outside its delivery record.

Delivery.title: Handoff Delivery
Delivery.description: One attempt to put a request in front of a person through one channel. A raise MUST NOT block on delivery: deliveries return `queued` and a channel outage never fails the raise.

channel.description: Open vocabulary. Adding a channel adds an adapter and a policy row, never a branch at a call site.

rung.description: Which escalation rung minted this delivery. Rung 0 fires at raise time.

state.description: Terminal states: suppressed, failed, bounced, acted, stale, cancelled. `cancelled` means the request settled before dispatch; `stale` means it settled elsewhere after dispatch.

suppressed_reason.description: Why a queued delivery was never attempted.

oneOf.description: dispatched = our transport accepted it. delivered = the channel says it reached the person's endpoint. seen = the person opened the surface, authenticated. acted = the person answered through this delivery.

max_grade.description: Declared by the channel adapter. A server MUST NOT record a grade above it. A voice page that cannot collect a decision declares `delivered`, and is then structurally unable to be mistaken for consent.

can_authenticate_person.description: Declared by the channel adapter. A channel declaring false may deliver and may collect an intent, but its answer is provisional and MUST NOT settle the request (I6).
